body: CONFIRMED, AND THE PRIMARY INSPECTION SHARPENS IT. The paper's Appendix 1 prints the full 328-word Bartlett stimulus, so the wording is recoverable even though OSF gptkz is not anonymously accessible. I visually inspected the rendered appendix and compared it with WarOfTheGhostsText.scala. Our 425-token Boas/Cultee source contains events and clauses absent from the experiment, so its checksum, spans, and some situations cannot be reused; a distinct source version and newly evidenced story artifact are required. The article is CC BY 4.0, but the stimulus is credited to Bartlett 1932, so third-party redistribution rights are not unambiguously cleared by the article licence. The original participant-facing lab-copy checksum and OSF component terms remain unavailable. Separately, gptkz currently returns 401 and redirects to sign-in, so raw-reproduction presence, deposit licence, and chain-key integrity remain Unknown. Updated record: docs/design/gptkz-primary-source-inventory.md; summary post-01M17K8V8NCPP11R2WHCFBBZ1Q. No stimulus or participant text was added to git.
